mapper.sql: select lr.leave_request_id, lr.emp_id, lr.start_date, lr.end_date, lr.days, lr.reason, lr.status, lr.request_date, lr.approved_at, lr.reject_reason, lt.leave_type_id, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lt.is_deduct, lr.approver_id, ap.ename as approver_name, apj.job_name as approver_job_name from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id left join emp ap on ap.emp_id = lr.approver_id left join job apj on apj.job_id = ap.job_id
mapper.select: select lt.leave_type_id, lt.leave_type_code, lt.leave_type_name, lt.is_deduct, lt.is_active from leave_request lr join leave_type lt on lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id where lr.emp_id = #{empId} and lr.status = 'APPROVED' and #{date} between lr.start_date and lr.end_date order by lt.leave_type_id
